label: GO step, repeating choice a2, early-to-mid episode (trials < ~40)
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2) and almost only when the agent is about to choose a2 (99.8% of mass; model_act==2) and is repeating a2 (stay==0 rate 0.3%). Strongly gated by episode time: rate high in trials 3-39, falls off through 40-69, and is silent from trial 70 on, so it acts like an a2-stay signal that decays over the episode (agent may track elapsed time in its state). Stronger when the a2 policy logit is confident (choice < -5 adds little F1). Not modulated by previous reward, transition type, or core pattern; does not fire for a1 choices or switches to a2. The upcoming choice is the agent own computed action (allowed, not a future random outcome). Dev F1 0.80; precision limited by inactive a2-stay GO steps in early episodes.
